title: Beyond Synthetic Benchmarks: Evaluating LLM Performance on Real-World Class-Level Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2510.26130v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly from well-studied function-level code generation to emerging repository-level approaches, yet this progression reveals a critical gap: class-level code generation, which is the fundamental building block connecting individual functions to complete repositories, remains systematically underexplored. Understanding class-level capabilities is a prerequisite to repository-level success, as current approaches cannot distinguish whether failures stem from basic implementation deficiencies or sophisticated context management issues.   We introduce RealClassEval, a benchmark derived from real-world open-source repositories, comprising 400 classes divided into seen and unseen partitions based on model training cutoffs. translated_title: 超越合成基准：评估大语言模型在真实世界类级别代码生成上的性能
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）已经从研究充分的函数级代码生成快速发展到新兴的仓库级方法，然而这一进展揭示了一个关键缺口：类级别代码生成——作为连接单个函数与完整仓库的基本构建块——仍然被系统性地探索不足。理解类级别能力是仓库级任务成功的前提，因为当前方法无法区分失败究竟源于基本的实现缺陷还是复杂的上下文管理问题。我们提出了RealClassEval，这是一个源自真实世界开源仓库的基准，包含400个类，并根据模型训练截止时间划分为已见和未见两个分区。我们对七个最先进LLMs的系统评估揭示了被合成基准所掩盖的根本性局限：虽然LLMs在合成基准上能够达到84%至89%的正确率……
tldr: 该论文提出了基于真实开源仓库构建的RealClassEval基准，用于评估大语言模型在类级别代码生成上的真实能力，揭示了此前被合成基准所掩盖的模型根本性局限。
